stem: Show that the density of nuclear matter is the same for all nuclei.
model_answer:
Mass of a nucleus $\approx Am$; radius $R=R_0A^{1/3}$, so volume $=\tfrac43\pi R_0^3A$. [1]
$\rho=\dfrac{Am}{\frac43\pi R_0^3A}=\dfrac{3m}{4\pi R_0^3}$: independent of $A$ (about $2.3\times10^{17}$ kg m⁻³). [1]
